title: Citizens protest in Chennai over animal birth control centre issues and demands for accountability

ai.summary: Citizens in Chennai protested against Greater Chennai Corporation over animal birth control centre mismanagement, citing botched surgeries and inadequate postoperative care causing animal deaths and cruelty.

facts.claim: Citizens and animal rights activists in Chennai held a candlelight protest against the Greater Chennai Corporation
facts.quote: Citizens and animal rights activists in Chennai held a candlelight protest against the Greater Chennai Corporation

facts.claim: alleging mismanagement of animal birth control centres
facts.quote: alleging mismanagement of animal birth control centres

facts.claim: The activists claimed botched surgeries and inadequate postoperative care have caused cruelty and deaths among animals
facts.quote: The activists claimed botched surgeries and inadequate postoperative care have caused cruelty and deaths among animals

facts.claim: Complaints have been ongoing for a decade across multiple administrations
facts.quote: Complaints have been ongoing for a decade across multiple administrations

facts.claim: There are demands for better regulation, fair inquiry, and transparency in the use of funds for animal welfare
